name: Namdapha Jungle Camp Restaurant
why_it_matters: Wood-and-cane jungle camp on the Noa-Dihing river bank in Miao (Namdapha's gateway town, 25km before Deban entry). Owner Mr Phoopla Singpoh runs the kitchen + park trips. There is no permanent settlement inside Namdapha National Park itself; this is the closest sit-down option for park visitors.
insider_tip: Meals are for residents in practice — call ahead if you're not staying overnight. Carry cash; this far into Changlang district network and UPI both fail. The on-park alternative is the Forest Department rest house at Deban, also reservation-only.
signature_address: Noa-Dihing River, Miao, Changlang, Arunachal Pradesh 792122
